name: 干旱（监测/指标/评估）模型

map.输入同期降水量与多年平均降水量，计算降水距平百分率（Pa）与标准化降水指数（SP: Enter the concurrent precipitation and the multi-year mean precipitation to compute the precipitation anomaly percentage (Pa) and the Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI), automatically determining the drought grade and giving response advice.
map.📖 查看「干旱评估计算模型 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Drought Assessment Calculation Model User Guide"
map.干旱评估用两类指标：降水距平百分率 Pa=(当前降水量−同期均值)÷同期均值×1: Drought assessment uses two indices: the precipitation anomaly percentage Pa = (current precipitation − concurrent mean) ÷ concurrent mean × 100%, graded by Pa thresholds (≥−15% no drought, −30% mild, −50% moderate, −70% severe, <−70% extreme); and the Standardized Precipitation Index SPI = (current − mean) ÷ standard deviation, graded by SPI thresholds (≥−0.5 no drought, −1.0 mild, −1.5 moderate, −2.0 severe, <−2.0 extreme), used for multi-timescale drought monitoring.
map.当前时段降水量 P（mm）: Precipitation of the current period P (mm)
map.降水距平百分率 Pa = (P - P̄) / P̄ × 100%: Precipitation anomaly percentage Pa = (P - P̄) / P̄ × 100%
map.降水距平百分率Pa适用于快速评估，需多年（≥30年）气象数据: The precipitation anomaly percentage Pa suits rapid assessment and requires multi-year (≥30 years) meteorological data
map.SPI采用Z-score近似法，精确值需用Gamma分布拟合: SPI uses the Z-score approximation; precise values require Gamma distribution fitting
map.SPI-1/3监测短期气象干旱，SPI-6/12监测长期水文干旱: SPI-1/3 monitors short-term meteorological drought, SPI-6/12 monitors long-term hydrological drought
map.干旱评估需结合土壤墒情、径流量等综合判断: Drought assessment must combine soil moisture, runoff and other factors for a comprehensive judgment
map.对某区域按历史极值与暴露度评气象灾害等级。: Grade meteorological disasters for a region by historical extremes and exposure.
map.基建选址看台风/暴雨/雷电综合风险。: For infrastructure siting, look at the combined typhoon/rainstorm/lightning risk.
map.出具风险分级支撑保险与预案。: Produce risk grading to support insurance and contingency planning.
map.某园区台风最大风速 33m/s（12级）、年暴雨日 12、雷暴日 80 → 三项: A park with a typhoon max wind speed of 33 m/s (force 12), 12 rainstorm days and 80 thunderstorm days per year → the three weighted terms give a risk index of 78/100 (High); recommend Class I lightning protection plus drainage.
map.风险指数<40 低、40–70 中、>70 高；该园区 78 落高风险，须按高等: Risk index <40 Low, 40-70 Medium, >70 High; the park at 78 falls in the high-risk band and must be equipped with defense facilities at the high grade.
map.靠什么数据？: What data does it rely on?
map.历史极值（最大风速、最大雨量）、频率、暴露人口/资产，缺长时间序列会偏保守。: Historical extremes (max wind speed, max rainfall), frequency, exposed population/assets; lacking a long time series makes it conservative.
map.指数高就一定受灾？: Does a high index mean disaster is certain?
map.不一定，指数是「可能性×后果」的量级，配合防御能力才决定实际损失。: Not necessarily; the index is a magnitude of "likelihood × consequence", and actual losses depend on defense capability.
map.干旱评估计算工具，支持降水距平百分率（Pa）和标准化降水指数（SPI）两种干旱指: A drought assessment tool supporting two drought indices, the precipitation anomaly percentage (Pa) and the Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI), automatically determining the five-level drought grade: no drought / mild / moderate / severe / extreme.
map.SPI标准化降水指数计算（多时间尺度）: SPI standardized precipitation index computation (multiple time scales)
map.气象干旱监测与预警: Meteorological drought monitoring and early warning
